title: Tap, Tap, Pop!
lines: I am Sam. Dad is on the nap mat.
"Sit, Dad!" I said. Tap, tap, tap.
Dad did not sit. Dad did not nod.
I am sad. I tip a tin pot.
"Sit and sip," said Dad. I sat.
I nap. Dad did not nap!

questions.listenFor: A tin pot. The story says it, so if your child is stuck, point to that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: What did Dad say when he sat up?
questions.listenFor: I am not mad. You want the idea that Dad was not cross, even after the pot went pop. Let them find the line with said in it.

questions.ask: Have you ever waited for someone to wake up? What did you do while you waited?
questions.listenFor: Any answer. Sam taps and tips a pot in the story — you are just linking it to their own day.
